title: Weather
label: ch:fr-weather
canDo: I can talk about the weather in French — quel temps fait-il, il fait chaud, il fait froid, il pleut.

payoff.summary: Use le temps in both its senses, build the weather with faire (il fait chaud / il fait froid), and say il pleut with the Latin pl- cluster French kept intact. The chapter's only lesson, so the payoff covers everything it introduces.
